description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Bartz (Fire)
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Master of Fire (0~2), removed after using Master of Fire two times

description.text: Increases Master of Fire level by 1 after dealing 100001 or 300001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Bartz (Fire)]

description.text: Keeps track of Master of Fire level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Bartz (Fire)]
